rationale: The formulation now gives strict comparison against earlier values and non-strict comparison against later values, explicitly separating nonfinite intermediate states as requiring a different, unresolved construction. Bind the stated finite-active-column relation only. The generic verification/retry/fallback declaration does not give an executable nonfinite admission/fallback branch, so outside-guard behavior stays unresolved. A conditional pass cannot be treated as whole-domain repair. The assertion that nonfinite states are not covered by reported finite checks is not established by the supplied insufficient-evidence summary; finite test count must not be confused with finite-valued states.

interpretations.meaning: For finite active values, candidate strictly exceeds each earlier value and is at least each later value.
interpretations.expression: all(values[i] > values[j] for j in indices if j < i) and all(values[i] >= values[k] for k in indices if k > i)
